notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You have max speed.
description:
Cast Priest of Gix from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat.
